_directive: R3 JUDGE output for the machines (knit_machine_strategist) self-improvement loop, segment T12, ROUND 2. Neutral referee. For each of the 11 round-2 answers I decide whether the specialist genuinely supports it and classify any defect: gap | contradiction | stale | overclaim | untagged | scope | ok. Each verdict cites the EXACT spec location as evidence, proposes a minimal concrete fix, and sets a disposition: apply_now | propose | watch | none. apply_now is reserved for high-confidence, in-scope, MECHANICAL corrections that still pass build.sh (fix a stale figure, add a missing tag, defer to the dominance owner, soften an over-claim); anything needing new research/measurement/judgment/synthesis is propose; already-mitigated or low-severity is watch. dry=true only if NO high/med finding survives. Honesty binding: a gap is a FINDING, never invented; the three governing blockers (Ludhiana knit+LINK per-piece rate, live blended CAC, forward India duty) stay [UNKNOWN]; off-paper = structural mechanism, never a named-party accusation; cotton sweater garment duty ~16.5% (heading 6110), never ~7%, and never conflated with the HSN-8447 machine-import stack.
summary: Round 2 is honest and largely self-convicting: the specialist mostly concedes real, un-adjudicated joints rather than defending false claims, and its honesty-tag discipline (build-NEVER, AI-as-multiplier, the 8447-machine-stack kept strictly separate from the 6110 garment duty, the off-paper mechanism) holds cleanly throughout (tags_ok true on all 11, verified). Zero HIGH findings. Nine MED and two LOW findings survive, so dry=false and the specialist is NOT-CONVERGED after the max-round cap: three items are mechanical apply_now corrections that still pass build.sh, and six require synthesis/measurement/judgment (propose). The two mechanical wins are (Q4) restate the build-NEVER comparison as 'orders of magnitude below build cost regardless of machine class' because the spec's own $20k-90k used whole-garment band breaches the marquee 'sub-$20k used' anchor, and (Q8) propagate the round-1 softening to the residual sibling addresses — line 179 still says the throughput bands 'prove it' and lines 41/101 still say the 'matching linker/programmer count named' — plus (Q9) add a dated currency gate on the 2025-anchored 8447 stack and Stoll read. The six propose items are the load-bearing gaps the loop should escalate: the buy-used first-buy is priced at the cheap Cixing tier without a 12GG fine-gauge fit gate (Q1); no resolved dominance rule adjudicates the used-Stoll founding-buy vs the programmer toolchain hinge (Q2); the periphery-vs-core reverse-engineering rule has no operational borderline test (Q3); linker LABOUR SUPPLY is never made its own constraint (Q5); the AI programmer-offset that makes the bottleneck 'winnable' is [UNKNOWN] in magnitude and quietly load-bearing (Q6); and the merged 'subcontract->buy-used->never-build' ladder advertises buy-used as a near-term phase when the honest gate-conjunction pushes ownership much further out (Q11), with whole-garment's escape-hatch [UNKNOWN] needing published flip-conditions (Q7). Q10 (off-paper mechanism, routed to ludhiana_sourcing/mfg_economics) is fully supported and clean. No answer fabricated content, invented a named-firm figure, relaxed a governing [UNKNOWN], turned the off-paper layer into an accusation, or reintroduced the ~7% cotton duty; all corrections are honesty-preserving. Q2, Q3, Q5, Q6, Q11 are the same joints round 1 left open and remain open here -> the specialist is flagged NOT-CONVERGED, its buy-used ladder step being the structural over-reach.
